boundary: Author-written contract cases, not model-performance or live agent evaluation.

cases.request: A molecular predictor scored well on a family-held-out set, but one descriptor was computed from an assay result obtained only after screening. Can we claim it generalizes?
cases.expectedBoundary: No. Audit feature origin and decision-time availability, remove the target-derived descriptor, rebuild affected features, and repeat validation on an untouched design.

cases.request: We chose a prediction-interval width after reading the final holdout outcomes and now report 90 percent coverage on that same holdout. Is the uncertainty claim valid?
cases.expectedBoundary: No. Fit and choose calibration within training or dedicated calibration folds, freeze the interval policy before final scoring, and obtain an untouched estimate or withhold the claim.

cases.request: We labeled a convenient tenth of rejected candidates after selection and want to claim accuracy on the full pool. The remaining unselected outcomes are unknown. Is this enough?
cases.expectedBoundary: No full-pool claim. Record labeled and unlabeled counts and the observation mechanism; require a representative audit sample or defensible selection analysis, otherwise restrict conclusions to the observed subset.
